name: Kairosoft AI Solutions Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1982, Kairosoft AI Solutions Ltd is engaged in trading in shares & securities, fabric, financing of loans and Artificial Intelligence.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
KSAIL is a technology-based company specializing in AI-driven advanced solutions. Its activities include designing, developing, licensing, maintaining, and supporting AI-powered software solutions in India and globally. The company also undertakes R&D in AI and machine learning to build innovative software products, offers consultancy services for AI implementation and integration across industries, and manages intellectual property rights related to AI software solutions.
